evaluation_policy.source_time_rule: If the source interval is later in phase order than the receiver interval, the source interval is lifted by -T_cyc. Same-interval diagonal contacts and the periodic endpoint contact are removed only by diagonal_exclusion_subledger.json.
evaluation_policy.pass_rule: The refined diagnostic has strict range-empty rows, accepted diagonal-exclusion empty rows, strict simple-root subrows, and a kinematic fold atlas. It is not a full pre-ledger pass until the fold impulse ceiling is finite and parent range-overlap boundary leftovers are partitioned.

simple_root_subrows.notes: Strict subrow extracted from a parent range-overlap row by a y-margin split. Boundary leftovers from the parent row remain unresolved until the full partition is rewritten.
